Inquiry Form Please understand that some inquiries, depending on its subject, may take more time than others to reply. Inquires that are considered appropriate for MinebeaMitsumi group companies to answer, maybe forwarded to them, and answered directly by them. Replies from MinebeaMitsumi or from our group companies are intended to answer your specific inquiry. Please do not use the content of our replies, in whole or in part, for other purposes. * We may not be able to reply to any inquiries of sales purpose and / or sales solicitations. Your personal information provided to us will be used only for the purpose of responding to your inquiry. All personal information is managed responsibly by us according to our Personal Information Protection Policy .
